title: Archive and unarchive a client - both lists update without refresh (setting off)
preconditions: Logged in as a firm admin. "Show archived clients (client list & client properties)" is unchecked. A disposable active test client exists that can be archived and unarchived.
description: Maps to AC 9 and AC 10. Source: GET-15733. Archiving a client with the setting unchecked removes it from the client list and client properties list without a manual refresh; unarchiving it brings it back on both lists regardless of the setting.

steps.action: Confirm the test client appears on the client list and in Settings > All client settings > Properties.
steps.expected_result: The test client is listed on both.
The client is archived with a success confirmation.

steps.action: Without refreshing the browser, view the client list.
steps.expected_result: The archived client is no longer shown on the client list.

steps.action: Without refreshing the browser, open Settings > All client settings > Properties.
steps.expected_result: The archived client is no longer shown in the client properties list.

steps.action: In Settings > All client settings > Archived clients, click the unarchive (refresh) icon for the test client, confirm, and click Unarchive.
Without refreshing, check the client properties list and the client list.
steps.expected_result: The client appears again on both lists, even though the setting is still unchecked.
